svg.title: Prepare dependencies before creating the VM
svg.desc: Image, storage, and network preparation can happen independently. All three inputs converge before VM creation. Create the VM with the approved target, permissions, compute capacity, and failover headroom, then commission the guest, extensions, application, and backup.
svg.text: Prepare dependencies before creating the VM
Read inputs 1-3 from left to right, then stages 4 and 5 from top to bottom.
A created resource is not evidence that the workload is ready.
